description: Radar earthquake headlines of the last 7 days matched to USGS events by place: strong words and outlets at the peak against the measured magnitude. Verdicts loud_for_size, in_between, size_fits, quiet_for_size, no_measurement. Magnitude is not damage. Earthquakes only for now. No AI. In honour of Stanley Cohen (1942-2013), author of Folk Devils and Moral Panics.
name: get_cohen_s
title: Stanley Cohen sensor: how loud do radar earthquake headlines sound compared with the magnitude USGS recorded
